title: Hirday Ram Is Murdered to Bury the Evidence

blocks.text: The Ramgharia party now treats murder as the price of preserving stolen wealth. A hired killer is rewarded, and Hirday Ram is lured into a routine scene of grooming and ease rather than into anything that looks openly violent.

While attendants are smearing his head with curd and preparing him as if for a bath, he is made vulnerable and then suddenly beheaded. The method matters: the page presents the killing as treachery carried out under false intimacy, not as death in fair combat.
The narrator closes with judgment rather than triumph. By choosing murder to protect plunder, the offenders lose both moral standing and any lasting claim on the wealth they tried to hide.
